text:
flo (events): idea 3: informal tapas + micro-trivia crawl this Thu? three short stops (each ~40min) so we can float: 1) La Casita (small plates), 2) Barrel House (drafts + trivia corner), 3) PuzzleRoom (tabletop minis). start 5:45 or 6:30? cap ~12. RSVP + if bringing a +1 and any allergies. :taco: :mag_right: :game_die:

ada: ooh love that. 6:30 for me. i can be on a team called "Snack & Slack" :grin:

sunil: 5:45 please. got an early run tomorrow. can bring portable speaker for a couple rounds if needed. :running:

zoe: 6:30 and vegetarian here (no shellfish pls). happy to sub in as scorer for trivia.

jon: im in either time but prefer 5:45. +1 (partner) is ok.

rachel: sad im traveling thursday  cant make it but pls take pics :camera_with_flash:

flo (events): noted. cap at 12 incl +1s. if we exceed ill split into two adjacent teams. planning a few micro-rounds: memes, general, weird history. anyone want to run a themed round?

ada: ill do a short memes round (5 Q).

sunil: ill bring a little prize (gift card) for the winning team.

ops-bot: Poll: "Tapas + micro-trivia crawl Thu - pick venue order preference"	 La Casita first	 3 votes	 Barrel House first	 2 votes	 PuzzleRoom first	 1 vote (ends in 10h)

zoe: FYI La Casita can do a small veg mezze for pre-order if we commit. happy to coordinate dietary list.

jon: if La Casita is first, ill handle the cover/reserve call for 6:30 slot.

flo (events): awesome. i'll watch the poll and lock reservations tomorrow noon. if you havent voted, react to ops-bot poll or reply here. i'll post final plan + calendar invite by lunchtime. :sparkles:

sunil: adding tentative to calendar now. excited for tiny trivia. :calendar:
